title: Fossil CO2 Emissions Are Set to Fall Slightly in 2026
paragraphs: Every year, a large group of scientists counts how much CO2 people put into the air. This report is called the Global Carbon Budget. It was published on 10 November 2026.

The scientists think that CO2 from fossil fuels will fall by 0.4 percent this year. Solar power, wind power and electric cars are growing quickly. People are also using less oil, partly because of a short-term energy problem linked to the conflict with Iran.

However, the news is not as good as it sounds. Coal use is going up a little, and India's emissions are growing by 4.4 percent. One of the scientists says that a fall caused partly by sudden events is not a real solution. Clean energy must grow faster.
